description: AgentStack MCP = Work Graph control plane. After session + context.project_id: agents.work_next (mcp_work_loop_v1) -> plan_claim -> plan_execute (CAS/leases). Follow packet.next_action; catalog/discovery.search only if no packet. One-shot CRM/upload may call domain actions directly. Spine: agents.plan_get -> agents.work_next -> agents.plan_claim -> agents.plan_execute. Auth: Connect (G-A174) or Device Code, then auth.get_profile, then context.project_id on every batch. Prompts: agentstack_session_setup, agentstack_execute_budget.
